propositions: The flat _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS bound (100,000 chars) refuses c9f7 (121,147 chars) at recovery preflight despite the context fitting in the verifier model window and the recovery product (22 criteria × 121,147 chars = 2.67M) staying under the ratified worst case (32 × 100k = 3.2M).

The constant bound conflates physical ceiling (model window capacity per evidence run) with economic ceiling (per-criterion fan-out cost), forcing arbitrary per-axis splits that chase a monotonically growing tail.

The physical ceiling must derive from the resolved verifier model's own context window (via MODEL_LADDER), and the economic ceiling must be explicit (3.2M interim, pre-banked-verification) to unblock re-certifications refused at preflight and enable window-aware scaling.

Plan-review call sites must remain unchanged when MODEL_LADDER moves to model_classes.py via re-export; the new own-window accessor returns the matched rung's window (not escalation max), distinguishing completion's no-escalation semantics from plan-review's escalation.
